meta.description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.

scientific_integrity.detail: Accurate representation of ETE 4 capabilities with clear scope boundaries (does not replace sequence alignment or phylogenetic inference)

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for tree analysis and visualization with explicit warnings about evolutionary interpretation (arbitrary polytomy resolution, species-overlap inferences)

methodological_ground.detail: Based on established phylogenetic methods (Robinson-Foulds distance, duplication/speciation inference) with proper scientific caveats

code_usability.detail: All code examples are syntactically correct with proper ETE 4 API usage and file handling patterns

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage of tree operations including I/O, topology comparison, gene tree analysis, taxonomy queries, visualization, with excellent reference organization and bundled helper scripts

reliability.note: Excellent quality and interpretation checks section covering parser validation, name handling, rooting decisions, and reproducibility requirements

performance_context.note: Well-organized documentation (327 lines) with clear reference map, 5 comprehensive reference files, and bundled operational scripts

agent_usability.note: Exceptional scope clarity distinguishing ETE from upstream tools (MAFFT, IQ-TREE); comprehensive ETE 3 to ETE 4 migration warnings; clear reference map for task navigation

human_usability.note: Clear installation with optional visualization extras; parser selection guidance; bundled scripts with uv run patterns; quick start with file handling best practices

security.note: Good file handling patterns with explicit open file objects; taxonomy data disk space warnings; minor: lacks guidance on handling trees from untrusted sources

maintainability.note: Excellent structure with version 2.0, clear license (GPL-3.0-or-later), 5 comprehensive references, version pinning (ete4 4.4.0, verified July 2026), and authoritative upstream links

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with allowed-tools including Python; bundled scripts for common operations; minor: iterator return values mentioned but memory optimization patterns not fully detailed

recommendations.title: Add iterator vs list performance example for large trees
recommendations.problem: Iterator guidance mentioned but no code demonstrating when to use iterators vs lists
recommendations.root_cause: Performance optimization advice given without illustrative example
recommendations.fix: Add example showing 'for leaf in tree.leaves():' (iterator, memory-efficient) vs 'list(tree.leaves())' (eager, high memory) with guidance on when each is appropriate

recommendations.title: Add reconciliation code example
recommendations.root_cause: Strict reconciliation referenced as alternative but no usage example
recommendations.fix: Add brief example showing species_tree loading and gene_tree.reconcile(species_tree) usage for formal reconciliation workflow

recommendations.title: Add guidance for trees from untrusted sources
recommendations.problem: No discussion of handling potentially malicious tree files
recommendations.root_cause: Security focuses on file handling pattern without considering adversarial inputs
recommendations.fix: Add security note: 'When loading trees from untrusted sources, validate leaf count and tree depth before processing to prevent resource exhaustion attacks'
